final_prompt: Use case: infographic-story. Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article. Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: NLog 在 .NET 中把日志按规则路由到不同目标并结构化输出。The reader should quickly feel: 装包、配规则、日志按需分流并变成结构化 JSON。Summary angle: 一条日志流经过路由规则枢纽，被分流到文件、控制台等不同目标，最终产出结构化 JSON。Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and 2-4 supporting narrative beats. Information blocks: (1) step 装包: 一个发光的接入节点代表安装 NLog 包; (2) mechanism 路由: 中心枢纽把一条日志流分成多条管道，分别流向文件与控制台形状的出口; (3) takeaway 结构化: 末端汇成一份整齐的 JSON 文档。Main metaphor: 日志消息像水流经过路由枢纽，按规则分向不同目标出口，末端汇成结构化 JSON。Subject: 一个发光的日志路由枢纽（中心节点），接收一条日志流并按规则分流到不同出口。Composition/framing: 单点聚焦加斜向推进，中心枢纽向两侧分出清晰管道，宽幅下保持可读。Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: energetic shonen-inspired manga look, clean ink lines, dynamic poses, readable action rhythm, bright restrained color accents. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist. Color palette: 深蓝、青色、暖橙。Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, and no more than 4 when strictly necessary, all sourced from the information blocks. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters or one required product/model name. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names. Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. Avoid: 代码雨、漂浮芯片、真实 dashboard、假终端输出、英文长标签、赛博朋克紫蓝光污染。
